title: Food's over there. This bee rolls a ball.
hook: Rolling the balls earned no treats, but these bees kept coming back
summary: Bumblebees repeatedly rolled small balls without a food reward. Researchers found that the behavior met criteria for animal play.

text: Researchers placed small wooden balls in front of bumblebees.
A clear route led straight to food. Yet the bees took a detour to roll the balls.

panels.text: Do they get a snack for that?

text: In this experiment, rolling a ball earned no food. Still, the bees returned and did it again.
Researchers found that this behavior met criteria for animal play.
In another experiment, the bees preferred the color of a room associated with ball rolling. A ball had become a stop on the way to lunch.

panels.text: Gotta eat. But first, that ball.
